# Yabanin Core

Yabanin Core is a self-hosted AI gateway with OpenAI-compatible endpoints,
provider routing, organization and agent credentials, request logs and an admin
console. Run the local Docker Compose quickstart with a mock provider, then
configure your own model endpoints and credentials.

Optional controls include caching, budgets, policy pipelines and signed lineage
records. Availability depends on configuration and the requested API. Recorded
region claims do not independently establish where a provider ran inference.
Cost estimates depend on recorded usage and available prices; missing prices
remain unknown. Core is licensed under Apache-2.0.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://yabanin.ai/docs/quickstart): Start the local stack, create credentials and send your first request.
- [Introduction](https://yabanin.ai/docs/intro): Core capabilities and operating model.
- [Architecture](https://yabanin.ai/docs/architecture): Services, request processing and deployment boundaries.
- [Compatibility](https://yabanin.ai/docs/compatibility): Supported APIs and client-specific limits.
- [Deployment options](https://yabanin.ai/docs/deployment-options): Choose a deployment for your workload.
- [CLI](https://yabanin.ai/docs/cli): Chat, offline spend analysis and operations commands.
- [Offline spend audit](https://yabanin.ai/docs/audit): Analyze local traffic files and distinguish estimates from invoices.

## Providers and clients

- [Provider configuration](https://yabanin.ai/docs/providers): Configure local and external model endpoints.
- [Provider keys](https://yabanin.ai/docs/byok): Manage organization-scoped upstream credentials.
- [OpenCode](https://yabanin.ai/docs/clients/opencode): Configure the gateway as an OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [Codex](https://yabanin.ai/docs/clients/codex): Client setup and compatibility limits.
- [Claude Code](https://yabanin.ai/docs/clients/claude-code): Client setup and compatibility limits.
- [SDK versions](https://yabanin.ai/docs/clients/sdk-versions): Supported client library versions.

## Routing and controls

- [Cache](https://yabanin.ai/docs/cache): Exact and semantic cache configuration and behavior.
- [Cache architecture](https://yabanin.ai/docs/cache-architecture): Cache isolation, storage and lookup flow.
- [Cache precision](https://yabanin.ai/docs/cache-precision): Semantic matching measurements and limitations.
- [Gateway performance](https://yabanin.ai/docs/gateway-performance): Performance characteristics and tuning.
- [Task classifier](https://yabanin.ai/docs/classifier): Classification used in model routing.
- [Policy pipeline](https://yabanin.ai/docs/pipeline): Request policies, detectors, mutators and staged enforcement.
- [Agent access](https://yabanin.ai/docs/agent-governance): Agent credentials, budgets and request controls.
- [MCP gateway](https://yabanin.ai/docs/mcp-gateway): Register external MCP servers and control access to their tools.
- [A2A gateway](https://yabanin.ai/docs/a2a-gateway): Configure agent-to-agent requests.
- [Tool policies](https://yabanin.ai/docs/tool-policies): Apply rules to supported tool calls.
- [Lineage](https://yabanin.ai/docs/lineage): Signed request records, verification and location-claim limitations.
- [Evaluation](https://yabanin.ai/docs/evaluation): Run routing and guard regression suites.
- [Shadow mode](https://yabanin.ai/docs/shadow-mode): Compare proposed behavior before enforcing changes.

## Security and operation

- [Security](https://yabanin.ai/docs/security): Authentication, secrets, controls and known limitations.
- [OWASP control mapping](https://yabanin.ai/docs/security-owasp-llm): Available controls and remaining application risks.
- [OIDC sign-in](https://yabanin.ai/docs/sso-oidc): Configure administrator single sign-on.
- [On-premises installation](https://yabanin.ai/docs/onprem/install-guide): Install and configure a deployment you operate.
- [Offline installation](https://yabanin.ai/docs/onprem/offline-bundle): Prepare the files needed for an offline environment.
- [Air-gap checklist](https://yabanin.ai/docs/onprem/airgap-checklist): Review dependencies and network boundaries.
- [Multi-region deployment](https://yabanin.ai/docs/multi-region): Configure services across regions.
- [Operations](https://yabanin.ai/docs/ops): Maintain a running deployment.
- [Secrets rotation](https://yabanin.ai/docs/ops/secrets-rotation): Rotate credentials and keys.
- [Backup and restore](https://yabanin.ai/docs/runbooks/backup-restore-rehearsal): Test recovery from backups.
- [Incident response](https://yabanin.ai/docs/runbooks/incident-response): Investigate and contain incidents.
- [Development](https://yabanin.ai/docs/DEVELOPMENT): Build and work on Core locally.
